newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Bufete Q2 earns 2.53 pesos/share.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Bufete Q2 earns 2.53 pesos/share.

text.p: Mexico's Bufete Industrial SA reported earnings per CPO series share of 2.53 pesos in the second quarter, reversing a 0.53 peso loss in the second quarter of 1996.
Profits per quarter were boosted by earnings of 206 million pesos in one-off items, such as the sale of its interest in the firm Mexpetrol, Bufete said in a statement.
Net income for the period was 171 million pesos, compared with a loss in the second quarter of 1996 of 35 million pesos.
The company's net sales for the quarter were 1.079 billion pesos, up 5.2 percent from the same quarter in 1996.
Operating profits of 48.4 million, exceeded by 36.6 percent the second quarter of 1996. The operating margin also rose, to 4.5 percent in the second quarter from 3.5 in 1996.
Bufete said operating costs fell 7.9 percent in the year-over-year period and helped boost operating margins.
"(Lower costs) were due principally to a reduction of 13.7 percent in administrative expenses given that projects in progress rose during the reported period," Bufete said.
The company added that, in its steel, mining and cement lines, sales were 306.7 million pesos compared with 208.2 million in the second quarter a year ago.

In urban construction and design, Bufete's income rose to 175.6 million pesos from 104.5 million. Infrastructure income for the second quarter was 118.7 million pesos from 51.1 million in the year ago period, the company said.
